ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var actionDate = now() as Date var owner = "UHIS" --- { national_id: payload.nationalID, street_address: payload.address.streetAddress, country: payload.address.country, city: payload.address.city, date_of_birth: payload.dateOfBirth, case_type: payload.caseType, last_name: payload.lastName, source: payload.source, national_id_type: payload.nationalIDType, update_date: actionDate, create_by: owner, phone: payload.phone, state: payload.address.state, postal: payload.address.postal, create_date: actionDate, update_by: owner, first_name: payload.firstName, email: payload.email }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Covid Case Master
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO cvd_case_master (source, case_type, first_name, last_name, phone, email, date_of_birth, national_id, national_id_type, street_address, city, state, postal, country, create_date, update_date, create_by, update_by) VALUES (:source, :case_type, :first_name, :last_name, :phone, :email, STR_TO_DATE(:date_of_birth, '%Y-%m-%d'), :national_id, :national_id_type, :street_address, :city, :state, :postal, :country, STR_TO_DATE(:create_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(:update_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), :create_by, :update_by)

db:select.doc:name: SELECT case_id
db:select.db:sql: SELECT max(case_id) AS case_id FROM cvd_case_master WHERE national_id = :nationalID
